title: Income Tax Act 2023 Section 341 – Tax VAT Point
main_content: Section 341 - Power to Amend Schedule The Board may, by notification in the Official Gazette, amend any Schedule to this Act: Provided that no tax can be imposed or rate of tax shall be increased by such amendment. Click here to see Bangla version Note: This is unofficial English translation. In the event of a conflict between the information on this website and the original Government publications or notifications of laws, rules, regulations, and SROs, the Government publications or notifications shall prevail. Moreover, as per Section 345(2) of the Income Tax Act 2023, if there is a conflict between the English and Bengali text, the Bengali text shall prevail.
